mechanism_claims.claim_text: TP4 has source-supported phenotype-level bactericidal activity against BV-associated bacteria and lower activity against tested lactobacilli; this is not promoted to a direct molecular target claim.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Primary paper does not directly assay membrane permeabilization or a molecular target for TP4 in this BV context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TP4 combined with disodium EDTA and chitosan is source-supported as an antibiofilm/microbicide formulation in mature BV-associated bacterial biofilms.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TP4 peptide plus disodium EDTA and chitosan formulation
mechanism_claims.limitations: The formulation effect is phenotypic; exact molecular mechanism of synergy is not resolved by the paper.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Stability/secondary-structure assays support formulation feasibility, not a direct antimicrobial target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The TP4 microbicide formulation has source-supported in vivo reduction of BV-associated bacterial colonization in a mouse vaginal infection model while preserving tested lactobacilli context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mouse colonization results are preclinical efficacy evidence and do not establish clinical efficacy.
